ideas.title: Offer Comparison App for Agents
ideas.description: Build an offer comparison app for agents based on Kyle Whissel's concept. The app will store data from all offers with ZIP Codes and addresses to show sellers the offer trajectory and suggest the best options. It will also provide insights for agents to help negotiate and write competitive offers based on real data. Include features for processing deal questions and incorporating CAR legal updates. Scrape conversation history from the Culbertson and Gray company contract channel on Slack for data.
requirements: Store data from all offers with ZIP Codes and addresses.
Show sellers the offer trajectory for better choices.
Provide insights to agents for negotiating competitive offers.
Scrape Slack conversation history for data.
